# Asia Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Elevated supply risk (71.8) and strong price pressure (82.0) mean buyers should lock in key analog and logic parts now.

## What changed
- Market supply risk holds at 71.8 (no change) while price trend stays at 82.0, both labeled “Elevated” and “Rising” respectively[1].  
- TSMC foundry loading up 56 % YoY through Oct 2026, tightening supply further[3].  
- Korea’s chip‑led exports jumped 100 % YoY in early Nov 2026, reinforcing demand‑side pressure on both supply and price[4].  
- Semiconductor PPI rose 9.1 % annualized over the last three months, feeding higher component costs[1].  
- Global chip sales hit $172.6 B in Sep 2026, a 148 % YoY surge, driving demand‑driven price lifts[2].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks**, stock **27,081** units, no on‑order quantity or next arrival reported.  
- Price **$5.56** for qty 1, **$2.51** for 1 k units.  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).  
- Supply risk **54.1** (Neutral) and price trend **68.0**; buy‑timing call **“Hold course”** because there’s a **59 %** chance prices rise but no strong timing signal[9].

## Alerts  

*(none)*  

## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – Supply **71.8** (no change), Price **79.5**, Confidence **High**.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – Supply **70.2** (‑0.1), Price **74.0**, Confidence **High**.  
- Analog & power management – Supply **69.4**, Price **76.8**, Confidence **High**.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – Supply **67.1**, Price **76.5**, Confidence **High**.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – Supply **66.4** (‑0.1), Price **79.6**, Confidence **High**.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – Severe supply risk 85.9, lead time 52 weeks vs 12‑week norm.  
- **SN65HVD230DR** – Elevated risk 82.1, 26‑week lead time.  
- **LM358DR** – Elevated risk 81.9, 26‑week lead time.  
- **TPS62130RGTR** – Elevated risk 81.6, 26‑week lead time.  
- **TLV9002IDR** – Elevated risk 81.1, 26‑week lead time.

## Outlook
- Chip prices over next 3 months: 66 % chance of rise, expected +2.17 % (range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑tested edge.  
- Chip prices over next 6 months: 52 % chance of rise, expected +4.34 % (range ‑8.79 % to +17.46 %); baseline trend.  
- Fab utilization (supply tightness) 3‑month horizon: 63 % chance of tightening, expected +1.82 pts (range ‑1.71 to +5.36 pts).  
- Fab utilization 6‑month horizon: 60 % chance of tightening, expected +3.64 pts (range ‑2.16 to +9.45 pts).  

## Negotiation angle
- Push suppliers for **firm lead‑time commitments** on the five high‑risk analog parts; cite 26‑week vs 12‑week norm to justify volume guarantees.  
- Request **price‑lock agreements** for logic parts flagged in the “Buy ahead / lock pricing” list, especially 10M08SAE144C8G, to hedge against the 66 % upside price probability.  
- Leverage the “Hold course” signal on IPB017N10N5ATMA1 to negotiate **flexible delivery windows** without premium, citing the neutral supply risk and modest price trend.
